description: Get the EXACT parameters that produce good output for this model + task type. Skips the 'tweak until it works' phase that wastes 20-50 paid generations. Community-tested configs (portrait / landscape / product-photo / cinematic-video / lo-fi-music / etc) — not the model's stale official defaults. Use whenever you're about to call model.generate(...) without explicit parameters.

model.description: Model slug to fetch parameters for.

task_type.description: What the user is generating — e.g. 'portrait', 'landscape', 'product-photo', 'cinematic-video', 'instrumental-music'. Drives which preset is returned.

name: get_parameters
